summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that, effective October 7, 2026, Ms. Auste Adelborg resigned as secretary of the Monaco-domiciled corporation, with the resignation expressly stated not to result from any dispute with the company. Ms. Charlotte Wheatcroft, a Chartered Company Secretary and Fellow of the Chartered Governance Institute UK Ireland, was appointed secretary as of the same effective date; she previously served as Company Secretary and Head of HR at a London-based sovereign wealth investment group. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed. The change is a routine corporate-secretary succession, not a forced senior executive departure, so no special-situation or deal angle arises; watch only for any subsequent governance or disclosure-control developments.
